description: Use this when one of the user's own sites is down, failing from some places, slow or alerting, and they want to know why right now, or want it checked from everywhere: "why is shop.acme.com down?", "is it failing everywhere or just in Asia?", "is our site reachable from every region?", "is it our certificate?". Requests the site once from every region FlareWarden checks from and returns each region's result, status code, DNS, connect, TLS and first-byte times, where a failure stopped, and the certificate's issuer and expiry, with a one-line finding such as "fails only from Singapore: TLS handshake timed out". At most 10 an hour for one site; a repeat within a minute returns the same result. Never returns page content. Not for past outages or why a site keeps alerting: use get_incident or review_noise. Not for a site outside the user's FlareWarden account: use check_service_status_url.

site.description: The site: its id, name or part of its URL.

name: diagnose_site
title: Diagnose a site now
